glosses: A set of non-physical psychological and social qualities that make one person distinct from another.

examples.text: The president has a unique personality.
Personality is individuality existing in itself, but with a nature as a ground.

Meanwhile Nanny Broome was recovering from her initial panic and seemed anxious to make up for any kudos she might have lost, by exerting her personality to the utmost. She took the policeman's helmet and placed it on a chair, and unfolded his tunic to shake it and fold it up again for him.

glosses: Charisma, or qualities that make a person stand out from the crowd.

examples.text: The best contestant shows most personality.
But over and over / I´ll be a fool for you / 'cause you got personality.

glosses: A set of qualities that make something distinctive or interesting.

examples.text: His writing has a lot of personality.
This functional concrete building lacks personality.
Dubbels typically have a rich, complex, malt-centered personality and a copper or caramel color.

glosses: An assumed role or manner of behavior.

examples.text: In his final act, the comedian takes on a child's personality.

glosses: A celebrity, especially one with a strong media presence (e.g. an actor, singer, or sports player).

examples.text: Johnny Carson was a respected television personality.

glosses: Something said or written which refers to the person, conduct, etc., of some individual, especially something of a disparaging or offensive nature; personal remarks.

examples.text: indulgence in personalities

examples.text: Non contents d’être inexistants eux-mêmes, les gens voulaient encore annihiler sa personnalité à lui, réglementer ses idées, enrayer l’indépendance de ses actes…

glosses: Qualité de personne juridique.

examples.text: La déclaration effectuée aurait pour effet d’attribuer la personnalité juridique à l’enfant conçu, qui disposerait alors de droits subjectifs. La détermination du représentant légal de l’embryon pourrait alors être aisée.

glosses: Ce qui est attaché à la personne.

examples.text: Il remarquait que, parmi les impôts institués au commencement du dix-neuvième siècle, il en était un, la contribution mobilière, qui avait justement ce caractère de personnalité.

glosses: Personne connue.
